items.q: The girl's name was Leah and when I arrived at her house... I was the one her daughter said that did it.

ctx.x: And it was at that time that Madelyn and I got married. I had said when I was younger that I would not get married until I was 35 years old and here I was, getting married at 21.

A funny story happened to me three months after I was married. I was sent a message to ge see a certain woman whose daughter I had been seeing at times before Madelyn and I became real close. The girl's name was Leah and when I arrived at her house, the mother took me in a room and told me very nicely that her daughter was pregnant. I asked her what did that have to me with me and she said that I was the one her daughter said that did it. So I told this woman that it was just three months that I was married and…
I also denied to others that knew about the affair that I was not responsible. The mother of the girl was not angry with me or upset and only
